About ÇAHSPAR

A New Academic Collaboration Ecosystem for Working Life and Social Policy

ÇAHSPAR is an academic association established to strengthen scientific research, academic collaboration and social impact in working life and social policy.

Our association aims to bring together academics from different universities and disciplines who study working life, social policy and related topics, and to improve the quality, diversity and international visibility of scientific knowledge produced in Türkiye.

ÇAHSPAR’s approach extends academic activity beyond individual research and university boundaries. Sharing knowledge, building lasting research partnerships, supporting early-career researchers, developing national and international networks and connecting research with society are central to our work.

Why ÇAHSPAR?

Türkiye has a substantial body of academic expertise in working life and social policy. Researchers at many universities undertake valuable studies on employment relations, employment, labour markets, social security, social policy, migration, youth, education, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, sustainability, social entrepreneurship and social change.

However, much of this work can remain within individual researchers’ and institutions’ academic circles. Potential partnerships between universities, disciplines and research groups may remain underdeveloped.

ÇAHSPAR aims to provide a platform for connection, collaboration and visibility.

Our purpose goes beyond bringing academics together under one roof. We aim to build a sustainable ecosystem where researchers know one another’s work, develop joint research and national and international projects, and where early-career academics can engage with experienced researchers. We also seek stronger links between research in Türkiye and the international academic community.

An Initiative Founded by Nine Academics

ÇAHSPAR emerged as a joint initiative of nine academics with different backgrounds and research interests.

They shared a belief that Türkiye’s strong academic potential in working life and social policy could be supported through greater interaction, collaboration and international connections.

By bringing their expertise together, these nine academics seek to develop their own research and contribute to a wider research community.

ÇAHSPAR is therefore independent of any single university, discipline or narrowly defined research area. We aim to be an open and inclusive academic platform connecting institutions, disciplines, research approaches and generations of researchers.

Bringing Research from Türkiye to the International Community

One of ÇAHSPAR’s key objectives is to make research produced in Türkiye on working life and social policy more visible and accessible internationally.

Türkiye’s distinctive experiences, rapid social and economic transformation and diverse policy practices make it an important setting for international research in these fields.

Research conducted in Türkiye therefore offers valuable insights for both national scholarship and global academic debate.

Through international conferences, academic networks, research partnerships, joint publications, international projects, workshops and other academic platforms, ÇAHSPAR aims to help researchers in Türkiye build stronger connections with the global academic ecosystem.

Our goal is both to share knowledge produced in Türkiye with the world and to strengthen researchers’ access to international academic expertise.

National and International Networks

Building networks and participating in existing ones are central to ÇAHSPAR’s approach to academic development.

We aim to strengthen communication between academics, researchers, universities, research centres, public bodies, civil society organisations and other stakeholders working on working life and social policy in Türkiye.

Developing connections with universities, research centres, professional and academic organisations and international networks across Europe and the wider world is also a priority.

We want these networks to support knowledge sharing, joint research, project development, academic mobility, joint publications, early-career researchers and new research agendas.

Growing the Ecosystem Together

One of ÇAHSPAR’s most important long-term goals is to build a broad working life and social policy research ecosystem that extends beyond its own activities.

Academics are at its centre, alongside early-career researchers, doctoral students, research centres, universities, public bodies, international organisations, civil society organisations and other stakeholders in working life.

Working life and social policy are academic fields that also directly affect millions of people’s everyday lives, working conditions, social security, wellbeing and futures.

Strengthening the connection between scientific knowledge and practice is therefore a core priority.

A Meeting Place for Early-Career Researchers

ÇAHSPAR places particular emphasis on the academic development of early-career academics and researchers.

We aim to create an environment where doctoral students and researchers at the start of their careers can meet experienced academics, share their research, receive feedback and access national and international academic networks.

We measure ÇAHSPAR’s long-term success through both our current work and the academic networks and culture of collaboration we pass on to future researchers.

From Research to Social Impact

We believe that the value of scientific research extends beyond academic publications.

Sharing knowledge about working life and social policy with policymakers, public bodies, workers’ and employers’ organisations, civil society and different sections of society increases its social value.

Alongside producing research, ÇAHSPAR therefore places emphasis on sharing, discussing and translating scientific knowledge into public benefit.

Through academic meetings, workshops, conferences, research groups, training, publications and communications, we aim to build stronger connections between academic knowledge, society and practice.

ÇAHSPAR’s Vision for the Future

ÇAHSPAR’s vision is an academic ecosystem recognised nationally and internationally, where researchers in Türkiye working on working life and social policy know one another, work together and maintain strong global connections.

In the coming period, we aim to:

  • Increase academic collaboration among researchers in Türkiye
  • Encourage interdisciplinary research
  • Support the development of national and international research projects
  • Strengthen participation in international academic networks
  • Increase the international visibility of research produced in Türkiye
  • Support early-career researchers’ academic development
  • Contribute to new research agendas in working life and social policy
  • Strengthen interaction between scientific knowledge, public bodies, society and practice

More Than an Association

We see ÇAHSPAR as an academic foundation for thinking, researching and producing knowledge together.

What began as a joint initiative by nine academics will grow through participation by researchers from universities and disciplines across Türkiye, building strong links with international academic networks beyond national borders.

We believe that a stronger academic future for working life and social policy depends on producing research, sharing knowledge, connecting researchers and bringing Türkiye’s academic expertise to the world.

ÇAHSPAR was founded to build this shared future together, for fairer working lives and a fairer society.
